read_this_first.what_universal_means: Universal ranges over the DOMAIN OF MATHEMATICAL IDENTITY, not the domain of humanity. A property is universal iff it is invariant across every region of reality in which the mathematics is the same. The object asserted to be shared is the map of all possible symbolic geometry — the classification of symbolic-geometric forms up to admissible transformation — not any notation, alphabet or inventory drawn from it.
read_this_first.why_it_matters: The assumed reader is not human, not necessarily alive, and shares no history with the authors. The shared object is RE-DERIVED at both ends, not transmitted or taught. Evaluating this program by checking whether its claims hold across human cultures is the wrong test and is the documented way to misread this repository.

Cure.what: drift self-detection against a RE-DERIVABLE anchor; a corollary, not the purpose
Cure.why_re_derivable: A stored baseline drifts WITH you — drift measured against a maintained baseline is undetectable under common-mode drift. An anchor recomputed from mathematics has no state to drift.

counts_are_not_claims.rule: Primitive, sort and operation inventories are properties of a PRESENTATION, not of the notation. The known sets are generating sets rather than bases, so cardinality varies by presentation and carries no information about the object. 'How many primitives' is a malformed question, not an open one.

registry_state.note: Generated, not hand-written. Do not edit these numbers — they go stale. Regenerate with `ruby tools/check-counts.rb --fix`.

verify_dont_trust.principle: The artifact never asks to be trusted, only re-derived.
verify_dont_trust.ci: none, deliberately — FAILURES.md F-036: four workflows existed and not one ever executed, so they published a signal that meant nothing. Enforcement is reader-run; tools/pre-commit is the opt-in local hook. Absence of a green badge is not evidence either way: run the commands.

honest_limits: Not value alignment. Format alignment is not value alignment; a consistent system can optimize something monstrous.
A shared map is necessary, not sufficient: sharing the classification does not fix which part of it either party points at. map-to-meaning is unbounded on the ledger. That is the gap.
Universality is not established: UL-IS-EMERGENT-UNIVERSAL has its precondition unmet.
Never write bare 'fixed point' — the Erlangen and RG fixed points are different objects (claims.yaml#TWO-DISTINCT-FIXED-POINTS).
The companion wiki (cosmiccodex.app, wiki.cosmiccodex.app) is wet clay: draft input, not authority.

contributing.negative_results_welcome: A failed prediction, reported as failed, is a valid contribution and will be registered as one. Do NOT patch a failed prediction to make it pass — this project's completeness score was once driven 32% to 100% by doing exactly that, and the result was worthless.
